steps.summary: Signed in to Odoo (session already active from replayed segments), navigated via Sales > Orders > Customers to the res.partner kanban, created a new contact named "fwod5-n3 Bench Customer" with City "Benchville" (city field was directly visible under the Address block), and saved it. The saved record (id=46, URL ...view_type=form&id=46, title "Odoo - fwod5-n3 Bench Customer") shows Name = "fwod5-n3 Bench Customer" and City = "Benchville", verified by reading both fields back from the live form. Screenshot: contact_saved.png.

Created a new Quotation for customer 'fwod5-n3 Bench Customer' (selected from autocomplete dropdown). Added one order line: product '[FURN_7777] Office Chair' (chosen from product autocomplete dropdown), quantity 3. Odoo autofilled the unit price at £70.00 (20% tax). The order line subtotal is £210.00, and the Untaxed Amount in the totals is £210.00. Also confirmed the customer's city (Benchville) appears on the quotation. The quotation was not saved/confirmed. Screenshot saved as quotation_bench.png.

Added a second order line to the unsaved quotation. Selected product '[FURN_7888] Desk Stand with Screen' from the autocomplete dropdown (different from the first product). Odoo autofilled unit price at £2,100.00. Set quantity to 2. The new Untaxed Amount in the totals is £4,410.00 (composed of line 1: £210.00 + line 2: £4,200.00). Quotation remains unsaved. Screenshot saved.

Changed first line quantity from 3 to 5. Odoo autofilled the subtotal to £350.00 (5 × £70.00). The second line remained at £4,200.00. The new Untaxed Amount in the totals is £4,550.00. Quotation remains unsaved. Screenshot saved.

Confirmed the quotation for customer 'fwod5-n3 Bench Customer'. The order reference is **S00021** (shown in the heading and URL). The statusbar now shows **"Sales Order"** (checked/active), meaning the quotation has been successfully confirmed into a sales order. No confirmation dialog appeared — Odoo confirmed it directly.

Successfully cancelled sales order S00021. After clicking "Cancel", confirmed the cancellation via the "Send and cancel" button in the Cancel Sales Order dialog. The statusbar now shows **"Cancelled"** as the checked/active radio, confirming the order is fully cancelled. Screenshot saved.
Verified all observed values from the live page without changes.

Read-only verification completed. Sales order S00021 status is **"Cancelled"** (shown as active radio in statusbar). Untaxed Amount is **£4,550.00**. Order line 1: **[FURN_7777] Office Chair**, qty **5**, unit price **£70.00**. Order line 2: **[FURN_7888] Desk Stand with Screen**, qty **2**, unit price **£2,100.00**. Contact 'fwod5-n3 Bench Customer' (id=46) has City = **Benchville**.
